title: Manage searchable text and retrieve ranked matches
goal: Model SQL Server full-text catalogs and indexes, then retrieve relevance ranks with table-valued search functions.

selectionNotes: Model SQL Server full-text catalogs and indexes, then retrieve relevance ranks with table-valued search functions.
Measured Windows x64 / SQL2025 CU10; EF11 GA records define measured coverage and retained exclusions.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires net11.0; no EF11-on-net10.0 route is offered.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared target. Exact recorded SDKs are verification baselines; current-release proof uses RC2, not GA.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared sample language mode; no C# 15-only feature is needed.

frameworks: Standalone Microsoft.NET.Sdk console; no web framework requirement

packages.name: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer
packages.reason: EF11 SQL translation/defaults; actual baseline 11.0.0. Pin SqlClient7.1.0 and Pkcs10.0.13 as in the complete standalone project.

packageAssets: EF11/Relational/SQLServer lib/net11.0; SqlClient7.1.0 ref/net9.0 and Windows runtime assets. Previous EF10 lib/net10.0 and SqlClient6.1.7 ref/net9.0. Exact dependency closure is locked.
providers: SQL Server 2025 with full-text installed, English word breaker, native vector(3), compatibility170 for the combined executable. Full-text alone does not require vectors.
platforms: Windows x64 console against local Docker Linux SQL2025; no other client platform or older server execution.
renderingModes: Not applicable: console/database consumer; no renderer or browser
constraints: Rank is an integer relevance score, not a probability. Full-text population is asynchronous.
Exact cosine distance scans candidates; no approximate index, recall or performance claim. No older-engine execution is established.
prerequisites: Use an empty exclusively owned playbook_ database through eng/Test-QuarrySearch.ps1. Restore locked dependencies online before running.
optIns: EF9105 suppression accepts experimental vector API risk in the combined sample. Exact VECTOR_DISTANCE needs no PREVIEW_FEATURES opt-in. Preview vector indexes and VECTOR_SEARCH are outside this example.
stabilityLimitations: Current sample uses EF11 RC2, not GA. Other client platforms and database engines unverified.
Weighted similarity is application policy, not measured relevance quality. Embeddings are controlled fixtures, not generated semantic representations.

sources.title: EF SQL Server full-text modeling and ranked functions

evidence.scope: Real SQL2025 CU10 full-text creation, CONTAINSTABLE/FREETEXTTABLE ranking, combined exact cosine-distance weighted query retaining semantic-only rows, and reverse cleanup. EF11 additionally generates forward/reverse migration commands from its model. No mocks or cross-compilation.
